snippet.title: Bringer (凡应) - Reveal Trailer - PC Test Recruiting - CN
snippet.description:
Bringer will be a new Fantasy Action RPG from China. This is the first trailer showcasing the game's cinematics and some sort of gameplay footage. This new Chinese IP will get a 10-episode Donghua (Chinese Anime) before the game release, so it will get some weight on story. 
There's a recruitment event ongoing for the first test in China next month, but you need a Chinese ID, mobile number, and the test has an NDA, so it will be hard to try I guess... 
No idea if it's single-player, online, gacha, console, or mobile, other than PC (the game is also listed for android and ios on TapTap).

- TapTap: https://www.taptap.cn/app/381023
